_comment: FinOps Foundation KPI correlation catalog (Phase 1). Curated subset of https://www.finops.org/finops-kpis/ that this MCP server can inform from scan output. Each entry maps one or more source tools to a KPI. 'compute' = the server can calculate a value; 'informational' = the scan relates to the KPI but the value needs the field below or external input. Keep this honest: never claim a value we cannot derive.

kpis.name: Cost per Gigabyte Stored
kpis.definition: Average cost per GB stored, influenced by storage tiers and data life-cycle management.
kpis.plainLanguage: What you pay for each GB of stored data this month.
kpis.exploreHint: Run scan_storage_tier_advice to see if moving cold data to Cool or Archive lowers this.

kpis.name: Hourly Cost per CPU Core
kpis.definition: Average cost per CPU core, giving unit-cost insight for compute.
kpis.plainLanguage: Roughly what one CPU core costs you per hour.
kpis.exploreHint: Run scan_optimization_advice or scan_idle_vms to find rightsizing that lowers this.

kpis.name: Effective Average Compute Cost per Core
kpis.definition: Average cost per core per month after amortizing unused commitment discounts.
kpis.plainLanguage: Average monthly cost of one CPU core across your fleet.
kpis.exploreHint: Pair with scan_commitment_utilization to amortize unused reservation/savings-plan cost.

kpis.name: Percentage of Costs Associated with Untagged Resources
kpis.definition: Percentage of cloud cost on resources missing a required tag, per your tagging policy.
kpis.plainLanguage: How much of your spend lands on resources that are not tagged.
kpis.exploreHint: Run scan_tag_recommendations to see which CAF tags to backfill and where.

kpis.name: Percentage of Costs Associated with Unallocated Resources
kpis.definition: Percentage of spend that cannot be attributed to a team, project, or application.
kpis.plainLanguage: Share of your bill you cannot yet assign to an owner.
kpis.exploreHint: Backfill allocation tags (Customer/project/CostCenter), then re-run scan_cost_by_tag.

kpis.name: Percentage of Costs that are Tagging Policy Compliant
kpis.definition: Share of cost on resources that satisfy your organizational tagging policy.
kpis.plainLanguage: How much of your spend is on properly tagged resources.
kpis.exploreHint: Run scan_policy_recommendations to deploy tag-enforcement policy.

kpis.name: Commitment Utilization Score
kpis.definition: Burndown of pre-purchased commitment capacity against actual consumption. ~100% is healthy; lower signals shelfware.
kpis.plainLanguage: How much of your reserved/committed capacity you are actually using.
kpis.exploreHint: Run scan_reservation_advice to right-size future commitments.

kpis.name: Percentage of Commitment Discount Waste
kpis.definition: Percentage of commitment capacity not applied to on-demand spend (wasted).
kpis.plainLanguage: The slice of your reservations/savings plans you paid for but did not use.
kpis.exploreHint: 100% minus your utilization. Investigate underused commitments for renewal changes.

kpis.name: Percent of Compute Spend Covered by Commitment Discounts
kpis.definition: Percentage of compute cost (excluding Spot) covered by commitment discounts.
kpis.plainLanguage: How much of your compute is on discounted committed rates vs full on-demand.
kpis.exploreHint: Combine scan_commitment_utilization with scan_cost_data to compute coverage.

kpis.name: Percent of Unused Resources
kpis.definition: Measure of unused resources such as unattached disks, idle NICs, and orphaned public IPs.
kpis.plainLanguage: Resources you are paying for that nothing is using.
kpis.exploreHint: Run remediate_delete_orphaned_resource (gated) to clean them up.

kpis.name: Computational Waste Percentage
kpis.definition: Spend that provided zero business utility, e.g. idle resources before suspension or over-provisioning.
kpis.plainLanguage: Compute you are running and paying for but barely using.
kpis.exploreHint: Run remediate_deallocate_vm (gated, reversible) on confirmed idle VMs.

kpis.name: Percent Storage on Frequent Access Tier
kpis.definition: Percentage of object storage held on a frequent (Hot) access tier.
kpis.plainLanguage: How much of your storage sits on the most expensive Hot tier.
kpis.exploreHint: Flagged Hot accounts with low activity are candidates for Cool or Archive.

kpis.name: Storage Decay Ratio
kpis.definition: Storage cost attributed to data not accessed within a set window (dark data).
kpis.plainLanguage: Share of storage spend on data nobody has touched recently.
kpis.exploreHint: Low-activity accounts in this scan approximate dark data; apply lifecycle policy.

kpis.name: CSP Cloud Budget Burn Rate
kpis.definition: The rate at which an organization is consuming its allocated cloud budget.
kpis.plainLanguage: How fast you are spending against your budget this period.
kpis.exploreHint: Risk levels in the scan flag budgets trending over. Adjust thresholds or spend.

kpis.name: Percentage Variance of Budgeted vs. Actual Spend
kpis.definition: Difference between budgeted cost and actual cost incurred.
kpis.plainLanguage: How far your actual spend is from what you planned.
kpis.exploreHint: Compare budget amount vs actual in the scan rows.

kpis.name: Anomaly Detection Rate
kpis.definition: Frequency and cost impact of detected spending anomalies.
kpis.plainLanguage: How often unusual cost spikes are being caught. Shown as a proxy: anomaly alerts triggered plus the number of detection rules configured (a true rate needs the count of anomalies that occurred, which Azure does not expose).
kpis.exploreHint: Configure anomaly alert rules so spikes are caught proactively.

kpis.name: Effective Savings Rate Percentage
kpis.definition: Return-on-investment metric across all commitment discounts and optimizations.
kpis.plainLanguage: How much you are actually saving versus paying full on-demand rates.
kpis.exploreHint: Realized savings from RIs, Savings Plans and AHB appear in this scan.

kpis.name: Percentage of Legacy Resource
kpis.definition: Percentage of resources running on older generation types vs modern equivalents.
kpis.plainLanguage: How much of your estate runs on older, less efficient resource types.
kpis.exploreHint: Modernizing to newer SKUs usually improves price-performance.

kpis.name: Carbon per Unit of Cloud Spend
kpis.definition: Carbon emissions (CO2e) per unit of cloud spend, ideally drillable by service category.
kpis.plainLanguage: How much carbon each dollar of cloud spend produces.
kpis.exploreHint: Carbon-efficient regions and modern SKUs reduce this.

kpis.name: Token Consumption Metrics
kpis.definition: Cost of token-based models based on input/output token usage.
kpis.plainLanguage: How many tokens your AI workloads burn and what they cost.
kpis.exploreHint: Prompt engineering and model choice move this number.

kpis.name: Cost per API Call
kpis.definition: Average cost for each API call made to AI services.
kpis.plainLanguage: What each AI service request costs you on average.
kpis.exploreHint: High per-call cost can signal an inefficient model or call pattern.

kpis.name: Percentage of Unallocated Shared Cost
kpis.definition: Shared expenses that cannot be directly attributed to a specific team or project.
kpis.plainLanguage: Shared platform cost not yet split across its consumers.
kpis.exploreHint: Use scan_allocate_shared_cost or scan_usage_allocation to split it.

kpis.name: Allocation Accuracy Index (AAI)
kpis.definition: Percentage of total cost directly and accurately attributed to responsible owners.
kpis.plainLanguage: How reliably your costs map to the right team or project.
kpis.exploreHint: Improve tagging and shared-cost rules to raise this.

kpis.name: Total Cost of Ownership per Workload
kpis.definition: Average full-lifecycle cost of running an individual workload (compute, storage, network, etc.).
kpis.plainLanguage: The true all-in cost of one workload, not just its compute line.
kpis.exploreHint: scan_vm_cost_breakdown decomposes a VM into all its billed meters.

kpis.name: Frequency of Data Updates
kpis.definition: Time between updates of cost data (e.g. since the last export refresh).
kpis.plainLanguage: How current the cost data behind your answers is.
kpis.exploreHint: The Freshness date in this tool is your data-update recency.

kpis.name: Cost Visibility Delay
kpis.definition: Time between a cost occurring and it being ingested, normalized, and visible.
kpis.plainLanguage: The lag between spending money and seeing it in reports.
kpis.exploreHint: Export-based reads are typically a day behind; live API is near-real-time.

kpis.name: Unified Cost & Usage Visibility
kpis.definition: Extent to which all relevant cost and usage sources are integrated into one reporting system.
kpis.plainLanguage: How much of your estate is covered by one unified cost view.
kpis.exploreHint: CoveragePct in this tool reflects how much of scope the hub/export covers.
